download_multiobjective_model: download the multiobjective Light WhoAmI model to the specified datapath using the download function
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches the multiobjective variant of the Light WhoAmI model
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function which calls download_with_model_type with multiobjective and version v1.0
test_download_function: test the download function by calling it with a datapath argument to fetch the model
refactor_download_function: refactor the download function to support additional model types or version parameters
